<!-- Generated by `ovid2 manual gen-reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Transforms are CDM-agnostic, lazy DataFrame ops you compose into chains (from a mapper via `apply_transforms`, or over HTTP / MCP). Guide: [Transforms library](../06-authoring/transforms.md). Ops marked *spark* need a Spark-family engine.

## Correction

| Op | Summary | Params (* = required) | Engine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clamp` | Bound a numeric column to a [min, max] range. | `column`*, `min`, `max` | any |
| `coalesce_columns` | Write the first non-null of several columns into a target column. | `target`*, `columns`* | any |
| `dedup` | Drop duplicate rows (optionally keyed on a subset of columns). | `subset` | any |
| `default_value` | Replace nulls in a column with a constant default value. | `column`*, `value`* | any |
| `distinct` | Keep only distinct rows (full-row uniqueness). |  | any |
| `filter_expr` | Keep only rows matching a boolean column expression. | `expr`* | any |
| `null_if` | Set a column to null when its value matches a list, pattern, or bound. | `column`*, `equals`, `pattern`, `less_than`, `greater_than` | any |
| `standardize_null` | Convert sentinel strings (NULL, NA, '.', empty) to true null. | `columns`*, `sentinels` | any |
| `strip_non_alpha` | Remove all non-letter characters from one or more columns. | `columns`* | any |
| `strip_non_numeric` | Remove all non-digit characters from one or more columns. | `columns`* | any |

## Formatting

| Op | Summary | Params (* = required) | Engine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cast` | Cast columns to target SQL types using a {column: type} map. | `types`* | any |
| `derive_column` | Add or replace a column computed from a checked Spark-SQL expression. | `column`*, `expr`*, `cast` | any |
| `normalize_whitespace` | Collapse repeated whitespace to single spaces and trim the ends. | `columns`* | any |
| `pad` | Pad a column to a fixed width with a fill character (left or right). | `column`*, `width`*, `char`, `side` | any |
| `regex_replace` | Replace regex matches with a replacement string across columns. | `columns`*, `pattern`*, `replacement`* | any |
| `rename_columns` | Rename columns using an {old: new} mapping. | `map`* | any |
| `to_lower` | Lowercase the values in one or more columns. | `columns`* | any |
| `to_title` | Title-case (initcap) the values in one or more columns. | `columns`* | any |
| `to_upper` | Uppercase the values in one or more columns. | `columns`* | any |
| `trim` | Strip leading and trailing whitespace from one or more columns. | `columns`* | any |

## Reshape

| Op | Summary | Params (* = required) | Engine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `add_row_number` | Add a 1-based row_number within partitions, ordered by columns. | `partition_by`, `order_by`*, `output_column`* | spark |
| `dense_rank` | Add a dense rank (no gaps for ties) within partitions. | `partition_by`, `order_by`*, `output_column`* | spark |
| `drop_columns` | Remove the listed columns. | `columns`* | any |
| `explode` | Expand an array or map column into one row per element. | `column`*, `alias` | any |
| `pivot` | Pivot a key/value column pair into wide columns per key. | `group_by`*, `pivot_column`*, `value_column`*, `agg` | any |
| `rank` | Add a rank (with gaps for ties) within partitions. | `partition_by`, `order_by`*, `output_column`* | spark |
| `reduce` | Group by key columns and aggregate the rest (one row per group). | `group_by`*, `aggs`* | any |
| `select_columns` | Keep only the listed columns, in the given order. | `columns`* | any |
| `unpivot` | Melt wide value columns into long (name, value) rows. | `id_columns`*, `value_columns`*, `name_to`*, `value_to`* | any |

## Sampling

| Op | Summary | Params (* = required) | Engine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `head_by_group` | Keep the top-N rows per group by an ordering (e.g. latest per key). | `partition_by`*, `order_by`*, `n`* | spark |
| `limit` | Keep at most N rows. | `n`* | any |
| `random_sample` | Take a random fraction of rows (optionally seeded, reproducible). | `fraction`*, `seed`, `with_replacement` | any |
| `stratified_sample` | Sample a per-key fraction of rows, preserving key distribution. | `key`*, `fractions`*, `seed` | spark |
